title: Add recipe scaling helpers
description: Add reusable `RecipeScale` helpers for scaling individual quantities and full recipes without mutating non-ingredient content.
acceptance_criteria: `RecipeScale.scaled(_ quantity:)` scales numeric quantities and leaves text quantities unchanged.
`RecipeScale.scaled(_ recipe:)` returns a copy with all ingredient quantities scaled by factor.
Cookware, timers, text content, metadata, and section structure remain unchanged.

handoff_summary.completed: Both acceptance-criteria methods implemented: `RecipeScale.scaled(_ quantity:)` and `RecipeScale.scaled(_ recipe:)`. All three acceptance criteria are satisfied.
handoff_summary.risks: None. Changes are additive (new methods only) and do not touch any existing method.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent should write unit tests for `scaled(_ quantity:)` (numeric scales, text passthrough, nil-quantity ingredient) and `scaled(_ recipe:)` (ingredient quantities scaled, cookware/timers/metadata/sections unchanged).
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: None — only new methods added to an existing enum; no API surface changed.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Returns `Quantity` (not `String`) from `scaled(_ quantity:)` so callers can compose further transformations and the recipe copy contains proper typed data rather than rendered strings.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: No tests exist yet for the new methods. Tester bead should cover: `.number` scaling at each `RecipeScale` case, `.text` passthrough, ingredient with `nil` quantity, full recipe round-trip with cookware/timers/metadata/sections invariant checks.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: SourceKit reports `No such module 'CookbookCore'` in the worktree due to missing derived data — this is a pre-existing diagnostic unrelated to the changes (the original file had the same import).

conflict_risks: None — only new methods added to an existing enum; no API surface changed.

execution_history.summary: Added `scaled(_ quantity:) -> Quantity` and `scaled(_ recipe:) -> Recipe` helpers to the existing `RecipeScale` enum. Numeric quantities are multiplied by `factor`; text quantities are returned unchanged. Only `recipe.ingredients` are mutated in the recipe copy — cookware, timers, metadata, and sections pass through as-is.
